inputs.text: A premium hand painted 2D side scrolling fantasy action RPG environment background, panoramic wide horizontal composition. Ember Basilica, vast ruined gothic sanctuary with dark carved basalt pillars, intricate bronze tracery, red and amber stained glass, broken grand arches and monumental dark altar in the distance, warm orange braziers at the back wall, faded crimson velvet banners, ash and mysterious smoky depth. Elegant intricate art matching a detailed silver-armored anime knight game. Strict SIDE VIEW belt scroll camera, NOT overhead, NOT isometric. The bottom forty percent is a wide unobstructed flat horizontal combat lane made of dark warm stone paving with subtle gold mosaic lines. All architecture behind the lane. Horizon 55 percent down the image. Deep plum shadows and gold fire illumination, beautifully detailed stonework, polished commercial fantasy game art. No characters, no creatures, no text, no interface, no foreground objects or pillars blocking the combat lane.
